newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean bond yields end up on sluggish buying.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean bond yields end up on sluggish buying.

text.p: Yields on three-year benchmark corporate bonds finished higher for the fourth consecutive day on Thursday on lack of buying interest, brokers said.
Heavy new issues on Thursday, coupled with larger new issues expected for next month, also fuelled the rise.
No impact was seen from the death of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, they said.
Yields on three-month cerficates of deposits (CD) also gained as banks faced tighter liquidity and a rise in the yields on commercial papers (CP), they said.
